print_errors.note: Quran (7:180): the final ى of ٱلْحُسْنَى has no dagger alif in the print (only the fatha on the noon; checked at 2800 dpi), Tanzil has ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ; kept as printed. No waqf ۖ is printed after بِهَا (the quotation stops there); not added.
item ٢/٣: the lam of تكلني carries a fatha (expected sukun, تَكِلْنِي); checked at 2200 dpi; kept as printed.
item ٢/٣: waw printed detached from يا with a visible space; kept as printed.
item ٥: مُحَمَّد printed without tanween (items ٤ and ٦ have مُحَمَّدٍ); checked at 2000 dpi; kept as printed.

notes: p101 continues prayer (٢) of p100 (101+); p104 continues item ٤ of p103 (104+). p101 footnotes (١) and (٢) are printed with identical text; both kept. On p101 the list number (٣) is in parentheses at paragraph start (list number, not a footnote). p102: the centred line «أعوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ» is set in a bold font contrasting with the body, written as a bold paragraph (not a heading); the small calligraphic basmala written as the standard Uthmani basmala; the two Quran quotations and the bracket reference run in one justified paragraph; the flower-asterisk bullets (same glyph as p.049) written as '* '. Red divine Names on p103-104 (اللهُ، رَحْمَنُ، رَحِيمُ، مَلِكُ، قُدُّوسُ، سَلامُ) marked ==…== with the black commas outside. «الله» with a printed case vowel is written اللهُ (the ligature's shadda/small alif is the automatic font glyph; only the damma is an explicit mark), consistent with earlier keyB batches. Stacked marks over the article (e.g. الْمُسْتَقِيمِ, الْمَلِكِ, الْمَعْصِيَةِ, الْمَوْرُودَ, والْمُتَخَلِّقِ on p102) were resolved at 2000-3000 dpi as lam-sukun + vowel of the meem; المُتَخَلِّقِ (p101), المُتَعَلِّقِ، والمُتَحَقِّقِ (p102), المَحْمُودَ (p103) have no sukun on the lam and are written so. Final ى without the Lotus auto small alif per CONVENTIONS §2. Item numbering ٢/٣- written without the printed spaces. Quran spans checked with quran.py: only the ٱلْحُسْنَى / ۖ difference noted above.
